comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Released in the past as a bottle drop, this outfit's stats are:

+2 Accounts
+2 Crafts trading
+2 Alcohol trading
Female-only, 5k total fame to equip.

The male equivalent is Russian Gown -- also a bottle drop.

Source: wiki.ogplanet.com/uwo/index.php?title=Easter_Mystery_Bottle
